+- `generatedTokenIDs` (approx lines 1261, 1589) — local variables in `runGuidedGenerationLoop`/`runReasoning`.
+
+And in `Tests/MLXGuidedGenerationTests/StopTokenSourceTests.swift`:
+- `eosID` (approx line 14) — property, should be `eosId`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Rename all of the above to their lowercase-acronym-interior form (`entryId`, `toolCallsEntryId`, `reasoningEntryId`, `responseEntryId`, `suppressedLoadIds`, `generatedTokenIds`, `eosId`), updating every reference/call site.
+- [ ] No behavior change — pure rename.
+- [ ] Build clean, full test suite green (MLXFoundationModelsTests, MLXGuidedGenerationTests, and any others exercising these files).
+- [ ] A local review pass (`review sha` scoped to the commit) confirms zero remaining findings of this class in these two files.
+
+## Scope
+`Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift` and `Tests/MLXGuidedGenerationTests/StopTokenSourceTests.swift` only. Not urgent/blocking — pre-existing naming-convention debt, not a correctness bug.
\ No newline at end of file

+  text: |-
+    Rename completed and verified.
+
+    **Files changed:**
+
+    1. `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift` — mechanical case-sensitive whole-word rename (verified by grepping the whole file, not trusting stale line numbers):
+       - `entryID` → `entryId` (all local vars/params, incl. in `respond()`, `dispatchGeneration`, `runToolCalling`, `runGuidedGeneration`, `runTextGeneration`, `runUnconstrained`, `sendDelta`, `sendUsageUpdate`, `sendIncompleteOutputMetadata`, doc comments)
+       - `toolCallsEntryID` → `toolCallsEntryId`
+       - `reasoningEntryID` → `reasoningEntryId`
+       - `responseEntryID` → `responseEntryId`
+       - `suppressedLoadIDs` → `suppressedLoadIds` (property + all insert/remove/removeAll/contains call sites)
+       - `generatedTokenIDs` → `generatedTokenIds` (locals in `runGuidedGenerationLoop`/`runReasoning`, plus the `commitPromptCache` call-site argument)
+
+       135 occurrences renamed; verified zero remaining old-casing hits via repo-wide grep after.
+
+       **Important compile fix discovered mid-task:** several call sites construct the *external* FoundationModels SDK type `LanguageModelExecutorGenerationChannel`'s enum cases — `.response(entryID:action:)`, `.reasoning(entryID:action:)`, `.toolCalls(entryID:action:)`. That SDK's argument label is fixed as `entryID` (capital ID) and is NOT one of our identifiers to rename — renaming it broke the build with "incorrect argument label" errors. Fixed by reverting only those 6 call-site *labels* back to `entryID:` while keeping the *value* passed as the renamed local (`entryId`/`toolCallsEntryId`), e.g. `.response(entryID: entryId, action: ...)`. This is not a scope violation — the local variable is still renamed everywhere; only the immutable external API label was preserved as required by the SDK's own signature.
+
+    2. `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/PromptCache.swift` — one doc-comment cross-reference (`(e.g. `generatedTokenIDs.count`)`) in `reconcileCacheAdvance`'s doc comment updated to `generatedTokenIds.count` for consistency with the renamed identifier it exemplifies. This file was not in the original 2-file scope but was found via whole-repo grep per the task's instructions to check cascading references.
+
+    3. `Tests/MLXGuidedGenerationTests/StopTokenSourceTests.swift` — `eosID` → `eosId` property, plus all 4 call-site usages in `ListTokenizer(... eosId: ...)` constructions.
+
+    **Repo-wide grep confirmed:** no other files (including `IntegrationTesting/`) reference any of these identifiers — `IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/MLXFoundationModelsIntegration/Support/FMTestHelpers.swift` (the file with a documented pre-existing SDK-mismatch failure) has zero occurrences of any of these names, so it needed no changes.
+
+    **Verification:**
+    - `swift build` — clean (only pre-existing, unrelated deprecation warning for `LanguageModelCapabilities(capabilities:)`).
+    - `xcodebuild build-for-testing -scheme mlx-swift-lm-Package ...` — TEST BUILD SUCCEEDED.
+    - `xcrun xctest MLXFoundationModelsTests.xctest` — 157/157 tests passed.
+    - `xcrun xctest MLXGuidedGenerationTests.xctest` — 63/63 tests passed.
+    - `xcodebuild build-for-testing -project IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTesting.xcodeproj ...` — fails with exactly the pre-existing, previously-documented `FMTestHelpers.swift` SDK-mismatch errors (`_ErrorCodeProtocol has no member 'updateUsage'`, `no macro named 'require'`, etc.) — confirmed zero new errors, and confirmed via grep that FMTestHelpers.swift doesn't reference any renamed identifier.
+
+    **Local review note (logged, not actioned):** `mcp__sah__review review working` raised one finding suggesting `eosId` should instead be `eosID` to match `modelID`'s casing elsewhere in the file. This contradicts the task's explicit instruction and the established precedent from the prior `whitespaceTokenIDs`→`whitespaceTokenIds` rename in `GuidedGenerationLoop.swift` (confirmed 27 occurrences of lowercase `tokenId`/`tokenIds` there). `modelID` itself was intentionally left untouched — out of scope for this task — so it isn't good evidence for reversing course here. Proceeding with `eosId` per the task's explicit direction; flagging this for whoever reviews next in case `modelID` is a separate, future rename target.
+
+    Task left in `doing` per scope discipline — not moving columns or committing.
